# Botpress ADK frontend integration — chat UI, streaming and handoffs

Curated by Skill Harbor — @botpress's ADK frontend skill: the official integration guide for embedding a Botpress Agent Development Kit agent into your own chat UI. Covers the two core message contracts (createConversation and createMessage with payload types), REST APIs (conversations, messages, users), streaming messages, client SDK installation, authentication (token auth, client user keys), file attachments, messaging channels (webchat, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger), conversational handoffs between bots and humans, Botpress Cloud deployment, and a production checklist. Honest caveats: this is integration documentation for Botpress's own platform — you need a Botpress ADK project and account to use it; vendor-locked by design. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
